name: telnyx-developer-kit
description: Telnyx Developer Kit — everything to build with Telnyx in one install: quickstart, product navigator, architecture patterns, security guardrails, error triage, and a Twilio-switch guide, plus the telnyx-builder agent and the hosted Telnyx MCP server for live API access. Covers messaging, voice/Call Control, TeXML, WebRTC, Verify, numbers, fax, IoT, video, and Twilio migration.
